title: Bulletproof 1-button local release scripts + manual workflow_dispatch CI/CD for Windows & Linux
diff_summary: 1. build-release.bat: fixed cmd.exe syntax crash (. was unexpected at this time); added preflight auto-detection of %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin, %APPDATA%\npm, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\nodejs to PATH; collected artifacts into Release\Windows\bin and Release\Windows\installer. 2. build-release.ps1 & build-release.sh: added automated tool PATH detection for cargo, node, and pnpm. 3. .github/workflows/release.yml: enabled 1-click CI/CD release publishing via workflow_dispatch with optional tag_name input (publish-release no longer skipped); aligned Linux build dependencies with Antigravity-Tools-LS; automated matrix publishing of NSIS setup, MSI, Windows portable exe, Linux AppImage, deb, and Linux portable binary.
notes: Eliminates build environment failures for agents and local runs. Releases build to Release/Windows/installer, Release/Windows/bin, Release/Linux/installer, Release/Linux/bin.
